title: SID MEDICOS expands LemonBottle global webinar programme, drawing participation from over 20 countries
summary: Global beauty and aesthetics company SID MEDICOS Co., Ltd. announced that it is expanding the LemonBottle Global Webinar, an online education programme through which aesthetics professionals share their product experience and practical expertise

extraction.key_fact: 뷰티 및 에스테틱 기업 에스아이디메디코스가 에스테틱 전문가 대상 온라인 교육 프로그램인 레몬보틀 글로벌 웨비나를 확대한다고 발표했다.
